title: How Germantown I-270 Townhomes Load Your Air Ducts
headline: Milestone closets, Town Center grit, and why corridor construction never really leaves the returns
description: Germantown, MD sits on I-270 north of Gaithersburg. Learn why townhome ducts collect traffic dust and drywall grit, and when to clean them from Bethesda.

sections.heading: Germantown is an I-270 town. The ducts know it.
paragraphs: Milestone, Town Center, Waters Landing, and Clopper Road are mostly 1980s–2000s townhomes and split-levels. Mechanical closets were never meant to hold a decade of corridor grit. I-270 brake dust, construction cranes, and the next pad’s drywall all ride the same returns.
Filters catch some of it. Registers still gray out a week after you wipe them. Humid Maryland summers add a sticky film on cool supply trunks so the next cycle blows the mix back upstairs.

sections.heading: The townhome closet is doing three jobs badly
paragraphs: It holds the air handler, a long dryer run, and a decade of lint. None of those were designed for today’s machines or today’s traffic. A dryer that needs two cycles on a Milestone stack is usually the vent. The dust on the supplies is the ducts.
If wiping the registers only lasts a few days, start with [air duct cleaning in Germantown, MD](/locations/germantown).

sections.heading: Typical signs in a Germantown townhome
listItems: Gray film on supplies facing I-270 or a construction pad.
Musty air from a split-level lower level in July.
A hot laundry closet and long dry times in Town Center or Waters Landing.

sections.heading: Bethesda dispatch — not a Milestone suite
paragraphs: Germantown is served from our [Bethesda](/locations/bethesda) office. Nearby [Gaithersburg](/locations/gaithersburg) and [Clarksburg](/locations/clarksburg) use the same crew. There is no Germantown storefront.
Book on the [Germantown location page](/locations/germantown). Add [dryer vent cleaning](/dryer-vent-cleaning) if the closet stays humid.
listItems: Change filters more often if you sit on I-270 air.
Keep lower-level humidity under 50% in summer.
Clean ducts every 3 to 5 years; clear townhome dryer vents about once a year.

faq.q: Does I-270 dust really reach Germantown indoor ducts?
faq.a: Yes. Fine traffic particles and nearby drywall settle at returns. Filters miss what already sits in the trunks.

faq.a: No. Germantown is served from Bethesda, up I-270 past Gaithersburg. We will not list a mailbox at Milestone.
